newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash soymeal - Basis offers mostly unchanged.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash soymeal - Basis offers mostly unchanged.

text.p: Most soybean basis offers were unchanged Thursday, but dealers said end-users could probably find some bargains before the three-day July 4th weekend.
"A lot of processors are trying to get rid of some supply before the weekend, so you may see some really good prices today," said a dealer in the southeast.
Most merchandisers said that the markets were quiet before the holiday and reported few sales.
Supplies in some Illinois markets are still said to be burdensome, and some processors are expected to take downtime this weekend in an attempt to clear inventories, dealers said.
Trade sources expect the National Oilseed Processors Association to report the weekly crush at 23.9 million to 24.5 million bushels. That figure compares with last week's crush of 24.223 million.
NOPA will release its weekly crush on Monday at 0730 CDT/1230 GMT instead of Friday because of the holiday weekend.
